vsl_script.text:
PROTOCOL VSL. Target length 3 to 6 minutes. Adon or CC on camera, landscape, eye level, quiet room. Oasis Studio adds captions, b-roll, the screen recordings named below and the OASIS end card.
Rule for the whole video: say no number, result or client story that is not on the page. Prices are said exactly as the page shows them.

[BEAT 1. HOOK, 0:00 to 0:20]
On camera: It is Sunday night. You saved another AI thread this week, and on Monday you will still be doing everything by hand. Here is exactly what we use. Copy it this week.

[BEAT 2. WHO THIS IS FOR, AND WHO IT IS NOT FOR]
On camera: This is for you if you run the business on your own, or you like building your own systems. You want the steps, not a retainer.
It is not for you if you want someone to set it all up for you. If that is you, look at COMMAND. And if you are not ready to spend anything yet, the free community is linked below this video.

[BEAT 3. WHY IT KEEPS HAPPENING]
On camera: The problem is not that you need more AI. It is that every tutorial starts from zero. You collect ideas, not a process. Without a written procedure, a prompt that worked last week drifts, and you are back to doing it yourself.

[BEAT 4. WHAT WE DO ABOUT IT]
Screen recording: the PROTOCOL library inside the OASIS Command Center.
Voice over: It works in three steps. First, pick the pack that matches where you are. Second, follow the SOP or blueprint step by step, using the prompts exactly as written. Third, when you want it running without you, move up to OS DIY.

[BEAT 5. WHAT YOU GET, PRICES SAID OUT LOUD]
On camera, matching the page word for word:
Quick-win SOPs and prompt packs, $17 to $47. Add an extra prompt pack for $27 if you want it.
System blueprints and workflows, $97 to $197, or two payments of $59. Add the video vault for $47.
The master protocol suite, $297.
The mystery digital vault for advanced builders, $97 to $395.
Note for the recording: once Adon picks one number for each range, say that number, and update this script and the page together.

[BEAT 6. PROOF]
No permissioned examples are confirmed yet, so show the product instead: screen-record one SOP being followed from start to finish. Use synthetic data only, never a real customer's details.

[BEAT 7. CALL TO ACTION]
On camera: Pick your pack below and we will send you a secure checkout link. Not ready? The free community is linked right below this video.
